== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Petrus is an elderly, stout [[Naraka Traveler]] characterized by his balding head and pudgy physique. He serves as an attendant or companion to Lady [[Adrienne]], assisting her with navigation and providing information regarding the nature of [[Naraka]] and its [[Incarnation]]. During a confrontation, Petrus demonstrated defensive capabilities by summoning a swarm of large, glowing orange wasps from his red-marked hand. During this conflict, he sustained a severe injury when the blade Azura severed his left hand at the wrist. Following the attack, [[Malachi]] applied a belt as a tourniquet to prevent Petrus from bleeding to death. Throughout his interactions, Petrus has acted as a guide, using the light from his glowing palm to lead others through dark tunnels.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Petrus is a pudgy, balding man who wears red robes. He is a one-armed individual with a bleeding hand that bears a red mark.}}
